name: STI-244FPM.docx
path: Drive第三轮/Marvell Based Industrial Managed Switch/L2/STI-244FPM.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Key Features
4*10/100Base-TX RJ45 PoE, 2*100Base-FX SFP slots
Redundant DC44-57V power input with polarity reverse/over-current protection
Comply with IEEE802.3af PoE and IEEE802.3at PoE+ standard
Layer 2 features: VLAN/Port Mirroring/IGMP/QoS/LLDP/802.1X
Fiber transceiver DDM/IPV6 management/Web/SNMP/Telnet/TFTP/Web upgrading
Support G.8032 ERPS protocol, recovery time≤20ms
Support 4KV surge protection and ESD: Air-15KV, Contact-8KV Protection
IP40 fan-less and Din-rail hardware design
Operation temperature: -40℃~+75℃
It is an ideal solution for IP surveillance, wind, electricity, assembly automation, subway PIS, power SCADA, sewage treatment, metallurgy, intelligent transportation, rail transportation, military and other industries
Specification
Product Name	6 Port 100M Layer 2 Managed Industrial Ethernet PoE Switch
Port	4*10/100-TX RJ45 PoE / 2*100Base-FX SFP / 1*RJ45 Console port(115200,8,N,1)
Network Medium	10BASE-T: Cat3, 4, 5 or above UTP(≤100 meters) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100 meters)
Network Protocol	IEEE 802.3 10Base-T / IEEE 802.3u 100Base-TX / IEEE 802.3x flow control and back pressure / IEEE 802.1D spanning tree protocol / IEEE 802.1w rapid spanning tree protocol / IEEE 802.1Q VLAN tagging / ITU-T G.8032 ERPS / IEEE 802.1X port authentication network control / IEEE 802.1ab LLDP / IEEE 802.3ad LACP / IEEE802.3af Power Over Ethernet / IEEE802.3at Power Over Ethernet plus PSE
Fiber Option	Hot Plug-able Module(LC), 100M based / SM: 1310nm/1550nm, 20Km; 1490nm/1550nm, 40~100Km / MM: 1310nm, 2Km; 850nm, 500-meter / Remark: 1*9 fixed module is NOT available on this model
Switching Capacity	1.2Gbps
Throughput	1.78Mpps
Packet Buffer	1M
MAC Address	8K
VLAN	4K
Jumbo Frame	10Kbytes
Transfer Mode	Store and forward, forwarding delay<5us
MDX/MIDX	Support
Watchdog	Support
MTBF	200,000 hours
PoE Protocol	IEEE802.3af(15.4W), IEEE802.3at(30W) / Remark: auto-sensing PD standard and supply compatible power
PoE Distance	meter / Remark: A PoE extender is required for longer PoE transmission
PoE Wiring	1/2(+), 3/6(-)
PoE Budget	120W / Max PoE output: 30W/port, 30W*4=120W
Input Voltage	DC44-57V, Redundant Input / Removable 4 PIN Industrial Terminal Block
PoE Output	DC48V, Active PoE / Remark: DC24V passive PoE is NOT supported / A PoE splitter is required if the powered device receives DC24V voltage
Input Current	3A Max
Total Power Consumption	Full loading without PoE≤5W
Reverse Polarity Protection	Support
Industry Standard	Surge protection of power: IEC 61000-4-5 Level 3(4KV/2KV)(8/20us)
Surge protection of Ethernet ports: IEC 61000-4-5 Level 3(4KV/2KV) / (10/700us) / DIP: IEC 61000-4-11 Level 3(10V) / ESD: IEC 61000-4-2 Level 4(8K/15K) / Shock: IEC 60068-2-27 / Free fall: IEC 60068-2-32 / Vibration: IEC 60068-2-6
Protection Level	IP40(Currently IP66/IP67/IP68 rated models are NOT available)
Installation	Din Rail or Wall Mounted(1pc mounting hanger is offered)
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS/Reach/UKCA
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -40℃~75℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~85℃ / Relative Humidity: 5%~95%, non-condensing
LED Indicator	PWR(Power indicator), Green Color / On: power status is normal
Off: power off or power connection failure / S(System indicator), Red Color / On: Normal operation / Off: Connection failure / Blinking: Device initialization / Ethernet Port / Green Indicator / On: port link up / Off: port link down / Blinking: data is in normal transmission / Yellow Indicator / PoE ports / On: PoE working / Off: PoE not working / Fiber port, Green Color / On: port link up / Off: port link down / Blinking: data is in normal transmission
Web UI
Above changes are free of cost(even for 1 piece only)
Default IP: 192.168.56.166
User Name/Password: admin/admin
Please contact us if you need to check
Web Manual
CLI Manual
Full Software Function List
Unavailable features
Below features are not available for now, and we are NOT going to develop it in 2 or 3 years
NAT
Stacking
SD-WAN
TSN
MPLS
Cloud Management
L2 Function
Port Aggregation	Support static aggregation / Support dynamic aggregation
Port Features	Support IEEE802.3x flow control / Support Port traffic statistics / Support port isolation / Support network storm suppression based on port bandwidth percentage
VLAN	Support access mode / Support trunk mode / Support hybrid mode
Port Mirroring	Support many to one port mirroring
Ring Network Protocol	Support STP, RSTP / Support G.8032 ERPS protocol, single ring, sub Ring and associated sub ring / Recovery time≤20ms(based on Marvell switching chipset under ring topology with Rapid Ring Protocol enabled)
Multicast	IGMP snooping
QoS	Ingress Port-based Rate-limit / Egress Port-based Rate-limit
Security Features	Support 802.1x, port authentication, MAC authentication, RADIUS service / Support port isolation
Management and Maintenance	Support LLDP / Support user management and login authentication / Support SNMPV1/V2C/V3 / Support web management, HTTP1.1, HTTPS / Support Syslog and alarm grading / Support RMON(Remote Monitoring)alarm / Support NTP / Support Ping, Tracert / Support optical transceiver DDM function / Support TFTP Client / Support Telnet Server / Support SSH Server / Support IPv6 Management / Support PoE management / Support TFTP, web upgrading
Application
Any network utilizing a mixture of copper and fiber
IP connectivity and communication
CCTV system such as network camera, access control
Mechanical Drawing
Remark

Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc wall hanger(shared holes with DIN Rail Kit)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
1pc console cable(USB2.0 to RJ45 connector)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 130*98*30mm
Inner box size: 184*150*50mm
Product weight: 0.55Kg
Packing weight: 0.7Kg
Master box size: 385*330*320mm
Packing quantity: 24Pcs
Packing weight: 17Kg
Remark
Accessories(DIN rail bracket, optical module, power supply, network cable etc.)are NOT included in the packing box
Please prepare it by yourself or purchase a whole set from us
